properties.digitized_from: Mission Rock Design Controls, Figure 6.2 - Maximum Height Plan (p.151) and Figure 1.1 - Land Use Plan (p.10); north edge is Verde's recorded lot line (8719C001), south edge is Block E's traced north edge.
properties.digitization_method: Traced from the Mission Rock Design Controls' own Figure 6.2 (Maximum Height Plan, p.151) -- an adopted regulatory diagram with a printed scale bar and street grid, not an illustrative rendering. Georeferenced using 5 real street-intersection control points (3rd St x Channel St, 3rd St x Long Bridge St, 3rd St x Mission Rock St, Bridgeview Way x Mission Rock St, Terry A. Francois Blvd x Mission Rock St), fetched from OpenStreetMap via this project's own src/fetch_streets.py and matched to their pixel positions in the diagram, then fit as a least-squares affine transform (never fewer than 5 points spanning the whole site, not just 1-2 nearby anchors). Cross-validated against the diagram's own printed scale bar and against the real, independently-confirmed positions of Verde, The Canyon, Building B, and Visa HQ (Building G) -- all four fell inside their correct named blocks under this transform, which is what caught and fixed an earlier, much worse-fitting 4-point version of this same transform (a block letter read one row off, producing 75m of error) before it was used for anything. Residual error against the 5 control points is roughly 3-13m. This block's boundary is a rougher rectangular approximation than the others -- the square's real shape in the D4D is closer to an elongated hexagon; treat its edges as lower-confidence than the surrounding numbered blocks. RETRACED 2026-09-17 (brief docs/briefs/mission-rock-geometry.md; definition of done in docs/site-definition-of-done.md). (1) SOURCE. This file's source_doc_urls pointed at the March 2012 'Design + Development Revised Proposal' (90 pages, no Figure 6.2) while the text cited the Design Controls, so the original pixel measurements could not be reproduced. Redone from the adopted Mission Rock Design Controls (April 24, 2018, sfport.com), Figure 6.2 - Maximum Height Plan (p.151), rendered ONCE at 300 dpi to data/manual/_reference/mission_rock_dc_p151.png (3300x2550 px, full page). Every pixel measurement below is from that one render. (2) TRANSFORM (one for the whole figure). Since this file was first traced, the Assessor subdivided Seawall Lot 337 (recorded 2020-06-12, mapped 2021-04-13): the four Phase 1 blocks are real lots -- A/The Canyon 8719B002, G/Visa 8719A008, B 8719C003, F/Verde 8719C001 -- whose recorded areas match the plan's block areas within 3%. The figure's drawn corners of A, B, F and G (colour contours, OpenCV) were matched to those 16 real lot corners and a least-squares affine transform fitted: RMS residual 0.67 m, worst corner 1.39 m (n=16); scale 0.2570 m/px (x) and 0.2598 m/px (y), ratio 0.989; axis angle 89.88 deg, i.e. no shear. The figure's own printed 200 ft scale bar measures 239 px on the same render = 0.255 m/px, agreeing within 2%. lon = 2.9127666757282e-06*px + 2.2156884853242e-07*py + (-122.39479060102); lat = 1.6823215817497e-07*px + -2.3273617315092e-06*py + 37.77752553008. (3) VALIDATION on real lines NOT used in the fit: traced C and D west corners fall 0.2-2.4 m from the 3rd Street property line (west edge of the undivided remainder lot 8719A006); D and H south corners 0.1-1.5 m from the Mission Rock Street property line (south edge of 8719A006); J, I and H east corners 1.1-2.8 m from the Terry A Francois Boulevard property line (east edge of 8719A006 / west edge of the TAFB lot 8719A003); the traced Block K corners fall 0.7-1.3 m from the corners of the lobe of the park lot 8719A005 that K occupies. Bearing check, the shear test that Pier 70's point check missed: real 3rd St property line 355.6 deg vs figure 355.3; real TAFB property line 355.7 vs figure 356.1; DataSF Exposition Street (Toni Stone Crossing) centerline 85.7 deg vs the figure's Exposition axis 84.9 deg, with 0.2 m offset at mid-block. (4) METHOD. Each block's fill (base colour plus hatched upper-building zone) was isolated by colour saturation inside a pixel window, its outer contour extracted and simplified (approxPolyDP, 1% of perimeter), transformed, and then any vertex within 3 m of a recorded lot line of 8719A006, 8719A003, 8719A005, 8719A007, 8719A009, 8719A010, 8719C001, 8719C002, 8719C004 or 8719D001 was snapped onto that line, so street frontages and shared edges are the Assessor's lines rather than the figure's 1-3 m of contour noise. Cross-checked against an independent trace of the same block on Figure 1.1 (p.10) through its own transform fitted the same way (RMS 1.1 m). (5) CHECKER. Registered in src/verify_block_fill.py under site 'mission_rock' (pixel window and colour rule recorded there); CI prints the IoU against the figure's own fill on every run. REBUILT 2026-09-17: Figure 6.2 draws Mission Rock Square as the white area bounded by Block F's south edge, Block E's north edge, and the Shared Public Way / Bridgeview Street property lines that F's and E's side edges sit on; Figures 1.1 and 3.1.1 fill exactly that rectangle green. The polygon is therefore Verde's (lot 8719C001) two real southern corners plus Block E's two traced northern corners, so it touches both exactly. Area 47,724 sf (1.10 ac), 4 vertices. The 57,626 sf / 1.32 ac in this file's regulatory_context is the March 2012 Revised Proposal's parcel table (p.22), which predates the adopted Design Controls; the DC figure draws a shallower square (the traced F-to-E gap is 80 m / 262 ft), so the traced area is kept rather than stretched to the 2012 number. The 2026-09-17 Verde clip recorded above is superseded: the north edge now IS Verde's lot line. Not registered in verify_block_fill.py: the square has no fill colour on Figure 6.2 (it is derived from F's real lot and E's registered trace instead).
properties.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE (planned, unbuilt public square) on the undivided remainder lot 8719A006. North edge is a recorded lot line (~0 m); the other three edges come from the Design Controls figure through a 0.7 m RMS transform (~1-3 m). Traced area 47,724 sf, smaller than the 57,626 sf the 2012 proposal gave -- see digitization_method. An interim plaza built with Phase 1 occupies the north part of this footprint today.
properties.why_no_real_parcel: A real Assessor lot exists under this square -- 8719A006, the undivided remainder of Seawall Lot 337 recorded 2020-06-12 -- but it has not been subdivided per block, so joining status.csv to it would paint the same ~9-acre parking-lot shape for every unbuilt block. Hand-derived geometry is used instead, with the lot's own lines wherever this square touches them.
properties.regulatory_context: Dedicated public open space (Design Controls Chapter 3, Section 3.3). Directly framed by Block F/Verde (north) and Block E (south), with the Shared Public Way (west) and Bridgeview Street (east) along its sides; Blocks C and I are one street removed. The Design Controls figure draws it at about 1.1 acres; the March 2012 Revised Proposal's parcel table gave 57,626 sf (1.32 ac) for an earlier, deeper layout.
properties.notes: Approximate polygon for the site's real, D4D-adopted future central plaza -- not yet built.
